observations: body L1-L29: Schiaparelli's addition begun on p. 221 goes on here; a heavy bracket closes it in L29, after a dash of 10.2 pt.
body L8, L14-L15, L17, L22, L24, L26, L44: the dashes of «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.2 to 5.5 pt), as those of «l. 28–29» (L22) and «207–210» (L44).
body L15, L20, L23: the whole greatest equation is 31m 12s in L15 and L20; in L23 Ptolemy's mean time is printed 0h 32m 12s.
body L21: in 31m 12s the Sun moves 1′ 17″ in mean motion and the Moon 17′ 8″; in 33m 30s the Moon moves 18′ 24″.
body L39-L43: in the head the dash after «c)» measures 10.2 pt; heavy brackets open and close Schiaparelli's second addition, the dash before his name 10.0 pt.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
